title: Group Deposits: Receipt, Refund, Application and Retention (Group Room Blocks)
content:
Group Room Blocks deposits are scheduled per block type, received while the contract is open, and then refunded, applied to the master account or retained, according to what becomes of the block.

### 1. Amounts and due dates

1.1 The signing deposit is the block type's signing deposit percentage of the contracted room nights times the group rate, rounded to the cent, and is due within the block type's signing-deposit period after the proposal.

1.2 The interim deposit is due the block type's interim due period of calendar days before arrival. A block type whose percentage is 0 has no such deposit.

1.3 Retired wording, kept for the record:
- "Deposits are a percentage of anticipated room revenue, the contracted room nights times the group rate, rounded to the cent" — **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of the interim deposit amount.
- "and the interim deposit is the block type's interim deposit percentage" — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis of the interim deposit amount.
- "Each scheduled deposit is received once." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current rule on receipts of scheduled deposits.

### 2. Receipt

Deposits are received only while the block's status is tentative or definite.

### 3. Refund

Deposits are not refundable where the block type's refund setting is No, except that a block cancelled without damages under the elimination waiver has every deposit refunded.

### 4. Application after the event

Deposits are applied to the master account only once the block's status is actualized.

### 5. Retention on cancellation

When a definite contract is cancelled, the deposits held are retained toward the cancellation damages up to their amount, and any deposit beyond the damages is refunded: the refund is the deposit held less the damages, never below zero. Deposits are retained or refunded only on a block whose status is cancelled.

### Status and permitted deposit movement

| Block status | Receive a deposit | Apply deposits to the master account | Retain or refund deposits |
|---|---|---|---|
| tentative | Yes | No | No |
| definite | Yes | No | No |
| actualized | No | Yes | No |
| cancelled | No | No | Yes |

### Retention worked through (hypothetical cancelled blocks)

| Deposit held (USD) | Cancellation damages (USD) | Retained (USD) | Refunded (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3,000.00 | 2,200.00 | 2,200.00 | 800.00 |
| 3,000.00 | 4,000.00 | 3,000.00 | 0.00 |
